description: This header file declares functions and includes related to parsing configuration files for the lighttpd server, including error handling and live configuration parsing.

methods.name: li_config_parse
methods.description: Parses a configuration file at the specified path for the server instance.

methods.name: li_config_parse_live
methods.description: Parses configuration snippets dynamically at runtime. Does not support includes or global variable modifications.

methods.name: li_config_error_quark
methods.description: Returns the GQuark for configuration error domain.
